_meta.purpose: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for per-field character budgets used by (a) the pre-parse summarize-to-budget re-ask in corpusChatService and (b) the validate_no_truncation.py Stop hook. Mirrors the canonical render-contract spec .claude/skills/nxt-visual-renderer/references/web-layouts.md. The no-truncation contract: the model summarizes each field to a COMPLETE thought within its budget at generation time; the renderer never truncates/clamps. If a field exceeds its budget, the re-ask compresses it; the hook hard-blocks anything still over budget.

_meta.policy: Budgets are the SMALLEST surface a field renders in. Positional hero/supporting nuance (e.g. theme-spotlight hero insight 400 vs supporting 220) is approximated by the larger value per template; the renderer is count-adaptive within budget.
